subject: Request: 30-day POC extension + additional pilot credits for Nimbus Analytics
messages:
From: Elliot Jacobs <elliot.j@Nimbus.ai>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: POC extension + more credits

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Nimbus is excited by the latency profile and cost numbers you showed. We're running into two blockers in the current 14-day PLG sandbox:

- Our dataset uses long-context time-series (avg 1.2k tokens per request) so we burn tokens much faster than typical PLG customers.
- We hit a rate ceiling when we ramp concurrent scoring for a subset of users; the default trial footprint is too small to repro production load.

Can we get a 30-day extension to the POC window and an additional $12k equivalent in usage credits so we can complete a scale run and an integration test with our pipeline? Attached is our most recent usage report and a short procurement form.

We'd like a yes/no by Friday (Jan 22) to plan our sprint. Happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful.

Best,
Elliot Jacobs
Head of ML Engineering
Nimbus Analytics
Attachments: Nimbus_Usage_Report_Q4.csv, Nimbus_PO_Req_Form.pdf

Can you weigh in on pos/cons from a commercial perspective and propose a recommended approval (credits + any special SLA/throughput guardrail)? If we escalate, I'd like final signoff by EOD Jan 22 so they can schedule the scale run.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-16T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: POC extension + more credits

Dylan — I reviewed the usage report and we have the following commercial recommendation:

- Approve a one-time 30-day extension to the sandbox.
- Provide $12,000 in pilot credits applied to their account, triggered on extension activation.
- Require a short mutual action plan (MAP) with three milestones: integration test, performance run, and procurement sign-off.
- Include a controlled throughput SLA for the trial (burst cap at X r/s) to avoid noisy neighbor risk.

Rationale: Nimbus is a strategic vertical prospect (FinOps potential across multiple units) and the ARR upside if they convert within 6 months is material (~$350k ARR target). The requested credit level is within our standard deal desk uplift for strategic PLG cases.

Conditions: marketing cannot reference them publicly without separate approval; no additional custom engineering work beyond configuration. If they ask for more runway (>30 days) we'll need Deal Desk + RevOps signoff.

I'll draft the terms for Deal Desk. Karthik — can you prepare a short addendum we can sign? Aditya — tagging you for awareness and exec signoff if you think this is within acceptable list price variance.

Laura
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Proposed-Bridge-Terms_Redline.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-01-20T14:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Re: Fwd: Request: POC extension + more credits

Laura / Dylan — I put together a one-page addendum (redline attached) that covers:

- 30-day extension effective on execution
- $12,000 one-time credit applied to the account; unused credit does not roll over
- Trial throughput guardrails and an explicit performance acceptance test (PAT) to validate results
- Standard security clause: customer must complete our SOC 2 evidence request before any production access; sandbox extension does not equate to production certificate.

Notes: I flagged a clause for Legal about data retention in the sandbox. If the execs approve the credit, Legal is comfortable with the redline but asks that Procurement sign the attachment indicating acceptance of the guardrails.

Karthik
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
